items.text: Indianapolis (final TNF report): OUT - LT Bernhard Raimann (concussion), RT Jalen Travis (knee), CB Charvarius Ward (knee), DT Jerry Tillery (calf), TE Will Mallory (hamstring). QUESTIONABLE - CB Sauce Gardner (calf, no practice all week), T Charlie Heck (personal), WR Anthony Gould (toe), LS Luke Rhodes (hamstring). IR - WR Alec Pierce, TE Mo Alie-Cox, LB Jaylon Carlies. Daniel Jones starts. Inactives come ~90 min before kickoff.

Houston (final TNF report): OUT - DE Danielle Hunter (hamstring), WR Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring), RB Woody Marks (concussion), TE Brevin Jordan (foot/illness). QUESTIONABLE - G Wyatt Teller (back), CB Jaylin Smith (hamstring), LB Jake Hummel (groin). IR - LB Azeez Al-Shaair (groin surgery). RB David Montgomery and WR Tank Dell full, no designation (Montgomery returns). C.J. Stroud starts.
items.source: Yahoo Sports / SI Week 11 injury report

adjust.reason: Indianapolis is without both starting tackles (Raimann, Travis) and CB Charvarius Ward with CB Sauce Gardner questionable after missing all practice, which outweighs Houston losing DE Hunter, WR Harrison Jr. and LB Al-Shaair. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
